title: lastrea filix-mas subsp. borreri
intro: Lastrea filix-mas subsp. borreri, commonly known as Borrer's lady fern, is a subspecies of the Lastrea filix-mas plant, belonging to the fern family (Dryopteridaceae). Borrer's lady fern is known to have various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can aid in treating conditions such as arthritis and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Borrer's lady fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
